IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped by tenant, principal, method and route. Same key+payload returns the persisted result; different payload returns 409.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional tracing identifier; generated by server if absent. Never an authorization input.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request or missing tenant context

Forbidden.description: Permission or separation of duties denied

NotFound.description: Resource missing or outside the effective tenant

ValidationFailed.description: Invalid field, decimal, source reference or checksum

DependencyUnavailable.description: Dependency unavailable or uncertain outcome; inspect operation before retry
